reason: For a club our size the 449 a month is not the problem by itself, but this sits on top of what we already pay, with two founders and not a single club live yet. I am not putting a yearly contract for our members' invoices and bar tab in the hands of something nobody has run in practice.
objection: Two people, no live club, and it touches our invoicing and payments. If they stop or fall behind, we are stuck with 950 unhappy members and a migration back, and I still have to pay the old vendor in the meantime.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing Golfclub Zwolle actually live for a full season, with their treasurer telling me invoicing and iDEAL work and that it replaced their old package instead of adding to it.
